purpose: Corrections to native draft claims, originals/checkpoint hashes preserved; this review does not constitute mobile runtime reception

corrections.finding: Declared react-native dependency is0.86.0, not0.79; declared expo range is^57.0.0. Installed/build compatibility is unverified.

corrections.claim: No socket.io/WebSocket dependency, no chat/stream implementation
corrections.finding: socket.io-client^4.8.1 and @pusher/pusher-websocket-react-native^1.3.1 are declared. Source contains socket-streaming/voice-related code. Absence cannot be inferred from truncated excerpts; functionality itself remains untested.
speech-streaming-service imports expo-speech. This disproves the asserted absence; no voice runtime test performed.
attachments-menu-sheet uses the uploadFile mutation with document form data. Runtime upload remains untested.

corrections.claim: Auth routes shown without base prefix, logout claims inferred from comments
corrections.finding: API client base appends /api/; auth route v1/auths produces /api/v1/auths/..., not root /v1/auths. The inspected service passes the token explicitly to signOut; its comment does not prove every storage-clearing step or device behavior.

corrections.claim: Legal conformity, active telemetry, minimum OS, version compatibility or complete absence of features inferred from excerpts
corrections.finding: Unsupported conclusions are not received. LICENSE header identifies GNU GPLv3; full distribution obligations and store compatibility require separate review. Dependency presence does not establish active telemetry, installed versions, minimum OS or runtime support.
